resolution: Startup 'map gone': diagnosed from the [mapgone] boot trace — data loads fine (world=present chunks=20 painted=72178 placements=108), so it is NOT data loss. The restored 2D view (seedView=11263,2878@0.07) passes isSaneView2d but is far-panned + zoomed to 7%, and both map panes were blank until a remount; the user worked around it by navigating to another route and back (forcing a re-render). No code change yet — the durable fix candidate is tightening the view restore so a non-empty map recenters to painted content with a usable zoom instead of trusting an extreme-but-technically-sane saved view. Left as review since the user self-recovered and the live thread moved to prop rendering.
